card.name: Inside words starting with Bor-
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the "bor" or "or" piece right after an initial B in words and names like Boraginaceae, Borrelia, borosilicate and boron. It also fires on a few place and person names such as Boloo and Barren.

modes.description: The piece "or" follows B in a plant family or a person's name.
